description: This file defines a configuration class for API automation tests within the OrangeHrm Selenium NUnit test project. It encapsulates settings such as whether discovery mode is enabled and API credentials, loaded from environment variables.

classes.name: OrangeHrmApiSettings
classes.description: A sealed class encapsulating API test configuration settings such as environment flags and credentials, with a static method to load configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Static method to instantiate 'OrangeHrmApiSettings' by reading configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: ReadBoolEnv
methods.description: Private static helper method to parse boolean environment variable values.
